topics.label: Introduction to the Hallmarks of Cancer Framework
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer outlines the learning objectives, context from previous lectures, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated Signaling Pathways Promoting Growth and Survival
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations in signaling cascades such as Wnt/beta-catenin, receptor tyrosine kinases, and TGF-beta drive independent proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how differentiation arrest prevents cells from exiting the cell cycle across both hematopoietic malignancies and colorectal carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis via the Mitochondrial Pathway
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through mutations in p53 and the dysregulation of pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality, Telomere Maintenance, and Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the mechanisms of telomerase activation that allow cells to bypass the Hayflick limit and overcome protective stress-induced senescence.

topics.label: Metabolic Rewiring and Oncometabolites in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics transition to systemic hallmarks by explaining the Warburg effect, global metabolic shifts, and epigenetic deregulation driven by mutated Krebs cycle enzymes.

topics.label: Induction and Regulation of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address why growing tumors require new blood vessels, when angiogenic switching occurs during progression, and how activator-inhibitor balances guide therapy.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Inefficiencies of the Metastatic Cascade
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic analyzes the multi-step process of metastasis, circulatory dissemination, diagnostic biomarkers, and the genomic features underlying secondary site colonization.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Future Perspectives on Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with final remarks on evolving hallmark frameworks, recommended reading, and upcoming practicals.
